caption:
In April 1976 Ron Wayne co-founded Apple with Steve Jobs and Steve Wozniak for a 10% stake. Twelve days later he sold it back for $800. It wasn't a dumb move: Apple was a partnership, its debts were his debts, and he was the one with a house to lose. He says he has no regrets.

Sunday special. Get this week's five, free every Saturday → link in bio.

#Apple #investing #stockmarket #history #startups

Sources: Fortune, Yahoo Finance, Outlook Business, Cult of Mac, 24/7 Wall St. (Apple value at the Nov 9, 2026 close). 10% of today's value ignores dilution. Not investment advice.
